title: Atila iAMP COVID-19 Detection Kit - Saliva (Pt.1)
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Arrange tube racks on deck
steps.instruction: Place tube racks in slots 1 through 7 on the deck in numerical order; the pipette will access them sequentially starting with rack 1 (slot 1). Within each rack the pipette will aspirate by column order (A1, B1, C1, A2, B2, C2, …). For a 94‑sample run fill racks in slots 1‑6 completely and place four tubes (A1, B1, C1, A2) in the rack on slot 7.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol software set the following: Number of Samples to the total number of samples (1‑96); Reaction plate type on slot 9 to either non‑skirted or half‑skirted (slot 8 must always use a non‑skirted plate); and specify the P20 Single‑Channel Pipette mount (left or right).

steps.title: Note sample volume
steps.instruction: The method reformats 10 µL of saliva per sample from the source tubes to the 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Add saliva to plate wells
steps.instruction: Using the P20 pipette, transfer 6 µL of saliva from each tube rack to the corresponding well of the 96‑well plate.
